map.选择集装箱类型与纸箱尺寸/重量，按体积与重量分别计算最大装箱数，并尝试6种摆放方: Pick a container type and carton size / weight, compute the maximum box count by volume and by weight separately, and try 6 placement orientations to take the optimum.

map.💡 实际装箱还需考虑间隙、堆码强度与装卸损耗，结果为理论最大值。建议预留 5%-: 💡 Real loading must also account for gaps, stacking strength and handling losses, so results are theoretical maxima. A 5%-10% margin is recommended.

map.按纸箱尺寸与集装箱内尺寸估算最大装箱数，优化装载方案与报价。: Estimate the maximum number of boxes from carton dimensions and container internal dimensions, optimizing loading plans and quotes.
map.同时受体积与载重限制时取两者的较小值，避免超载或装不满。: When both volume and payload limit the load, take the smaller of the two to avoid overloading or underfilling.
map.比较 20GP、40GP、40HQ 三种箱型的装载量差异，选择合适箱型。: Compare the loading quantities of 20GP, 40GP and 40HQ to pick the right container type.
map.对长宽高的 6 种摆放取向分别计算 nx×ny×nz（各方向取 floor(箱内: For each of the 6 orientations of length, width and height compute nx×ny×nz (each direction takes floor(container dimension ÷ carton dimension), in cm) and take the largest as the volume-based count; the weight-based count = container max payload ÷ carton weight; the recommended actual count = min(the two). Volume utilization = actual count × carton volume ÷ container volume × 100%. Internal dimensions and payload: 20GP 589.8×235.2×239.3 cm, 28,200 kg; 40GP 1203.2×235.2×239.3 cm, 28,800 kg; 40HQ 1203.2×235.2×269.8 cm, 30,000 kg.
map.纸箱 40×30×30 cm（单箱体积 0.036 m³）、重 10 kg，装: A 40×30×30 cm carton (0.036 m³ each) weighing 10 kg loaded into a 20GP: the best orientation gives nx=589.8/40≈14, ny=235.2/30≈7, nz=239.3/30≈7 → 14×7×7 = 686 cartons; by weight 28200/10 = 2820 cartons; take 686 cartons. Total weight 6860 kg (not overloaded), volume used 686×0.036 = 24.7 m³, about 74% of the 20GP volume (33.2 m³).
map.为什么理论装箱数常装不到？: Why is the theoretical count often not reached?
map.理论值按矩形完美堆叠计算，未计纸箱变形、托盘、加固材料与装卸间隙；实际装柜率通常: The theoretical value assumes perfect rectangular stacking and ignores carton deformation, pallets, reinforcement materials and handling gaps; real loading rates are typically 85%~95% of theory, so leave margin when quoting.
map.40HQ 比 40GP 多装多少？: How much more does 40HQ load than 40GP?
map.40HQ 内高 269.8 cm 比 40GP 的 239.3 cm 高约 30: 40HQ has an internal height of 269.8 cm, about 30 cm more than 40GP's 239.3 cm, and a higher payload limit (30,000 kg vs 28,800 kg); it clearly improves capacity for light bulky goods, while heavy cargo is still payload limited.
